analysis: Reviewed the head_text of landing/src/app/globals.css (lines 1049-3635), plus the patch excerpt, which is truncated. The visible changes are presentation-only: removal of the .story-section-heading rule (base 1574-1582) and a rewrite of the .closing and .closing-content layout from absolute positioning to grid and flow (head ~4014-4120). The patch hunks are not complete and the later ranges (head 4014-5980) are not supplied as numbered text, so those lines were not independently inspected. No scripts, URLs, network endpoints or data handling are involved. The one external reference is url("/logo.svg") for a local static asset (head line 2075), which is unchanged. The change has no apparent bearing on the provider threat model: TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, A-001, A-016 and T-041 are not touched. This is landing-page marketing CSS, outside the in-scope provider, native-runtime and coordinator-contract boundary. No cross-file interactions were identified. The only residual uncertainty is the unseen remainder of the patch, which is CSS and low risk.
